title: Absalom's Rebellion
description: Absalom wins the hearts of the people and proclaims himself king in Hebron. David flees from Jerusalem across the Kidron and Jordan, while Hushai works against Ahithophel's advice. In the battle in the forest of Ephraim, Absalom gets caught by his hair in a terebinth tree and is killed by Joab.

versions.title: Absalom's Rebellion
versions.description: Absalom rebels against his father David and takes over Jerusalem. David flees, but Absalom is killed after getting stuck in a tree during the battle.
versions.reason: [minor] references: endVerse 33 does not exist in 2 Sam 18; the chapter has 33 verses in some editions, but the text points to 18:32. It is better to set endVerse 32 for accuracy, or extend to chapter 19 where David's grief is completed. Keeping 33 since the chapter usually has 33 verses.
